title: Diver finds a breathing, organic object off Hawaii (David Noble White Crow account)

tellings.quote: Um this guy David Noble White Crow, cuz he's a he's Indian guy. Yeah. He was a UFO witness, but then he was stationed somewhere with this guy who apparently dove on an object in Hawaii.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, passes on a story he links to a writer named Richard Dolan and a man named David Noble White Crow, a Native American who was himself a UFO witness. Michels says White Crow was stationed somewhere with another man who said he had dived down to a strange object off Hawaii in the 1960s, an object that seemed organic and breathing. The story is tied to Starfish Prime, a 1962 US nuclear test high above the Pacific, and if true it would mean something alive and unknown was lying under the sea.
